title: Don’t book that China family trip until you know these 5 unwritten rules tourists learn the hard way
description:
Don’t book that China family trip until you know these 5 unwritten rules most tourists only learn the hard way 🇨🇳✈️

China is incredible for family travel.

Massive cities.
Beautiful culture.
Food your kids will talk about for years.

But the first time we travelled there with the kids, we realised something quickly.

China doesn’t work the same way many Western travel destinations do.

And if you don’t know a few simple things before arriving… traveling with kids there can feel overwhelming fast.

So here are 5 unwritten rules that made our China family trip MUCH easier:

1️⃣ Download the right apps before you fly
Many Western apps don’t work the same way there. Translation apps, maps, and payment apps can make navigating cities much easier when traveling with kids.

2️⃣ Always carry your hotel address in Chinese
Taxi drivers and ride share drivers usually read Chinese characters, not English hotel names. A screenshot saves so much stress.

3️⃣ Expect curious attention toward your kids
Chinese locals are often very warm and curious toward children. Some may wave, smile, or even ask for photos. It’s usually a friendly cultural interaction.

4️⃣ Plan rest breaks during sightseeing
Cities are HUGE. Walking distances are longer than many families expect. Snack breaks and rest stops keep everyone happy.

5️⃣ Have a simple safety plan with your kids
Busy train stations and tourist areas can get crowded. We always repeat a simple rule with our kids before exploring any big city.

Interesting fact: China has some of the busiest high speed rail networks in the world, moving millions of passengers every day between cities. That means train stations can feel like airports during peak hours.

But once you understand these little things?

China becomes one of the most fascinating places to explore with your family.
